desc:
[⚔️] Merge Defense 🛡️🏰

Build your team and defend your plot against endless waves of enemies! 👹💥

🎲 Roll and open crates to collect powerful units. 📦✨
🧩 Place them on your plot, merge matching units to level them up, and create the ultimate defense. 💪🔥
🌟 Discover rare units, powerful mutations, unique traits, new floors, and valuable upgrades as you progress. 🚀

🎮 Main Gameplay:
🎰 Collect and roll new units
🛡️ Place them to defend your plot
⚔️ Defeat waves and earn cash 💰
🔀 Merge duplicates to make them stronger 📈
📦 Open crates and discover rare characters 💎
🔓 Unlock floors, upgrades, mutations, and traits 🧬
📖 Complete your Index and build the strongest team 🏆

Can you survive every wave and become the ultimate defender? 🔥👑

⭐ Like & Favorite to support the game!
